item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD faced rejection at 1.3700 but buyers refused to give up
item.description: The GBP/USD pair kicks off a new week on a subdued note and oscillates in a narrow range, just below mid-1.3600s, during the Asian session.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in Saudi Arabia on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY climbs above mid-108.00s amid softer GDP-inspired JPY weakness
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross regains some positive traction at the start of a new week following the disappointing release of Japan's Q4 GDP report, which tempers Bank of Japan (BoJ) rate hike bets and undermines the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: USD/INR rises at open on bleeding Indian IT stocks refresh fears of foreign outflows
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens lower against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: More upside looks likely as 20-day EMA slopes higher
item.description: The AUD/USD pair trades 0.17% higher to near 0.7085 at the start of the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: EUR: Limited global demand caps ambitions – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen explains that the ECB’s expansion of its EUREP facility to all eligible non‑Euro central banks is aimed at boosting Euro liquidity globally and supporting the Euro’s international role.

item.title: India WPI Inflation came in at 1.81%, above expectations (1.25%) in January
item.description: India WPI Inflation came in at 1.81%, above expectations (1.25%) in January

item.title: Gold remains depressed below $5,000; Fed rate cut bets limit deeper losses
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to modest intraday losses below the $5,000 psychological mark heading into the European session on Monday, though it lacks follow-through selling.

item.title: USD: Policy risks erode premium – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research’s Philip Wee revises US Dollar forecasts lower versus most major and Asian currencies, citing rising uncertainty around Federal Reserve leadership, de‑dollarization trends and US political risks into the November midterm elections.

item.title: WTI stays near $63.00 as traders await geopolitical developments
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) edged lower after opening above its previous close, trading around $62.80 per barrel during the Asian hours on Monday. Crude Oil prices were little changed as traders remained cautious amid ongoing geopolitical developments.
